name: Jiangxi JDL Environmental Protection Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangxi JDL Environmental Protection Co., Ltd. provides water environmental treatment services in China. Its water pollution control equipment comprises a sewage lifting system, aeration system, membrane system, water production system, backwashing system, electrical system, shell and other standard components, and box type and tank type water pollution control equipment. The company also engages in design, material procurement, pre-processing and secondary development, on-site system integration, and commissioning, as well as providing after-sales maintenance services; environmental research and development; manufacturing, processing, and sale of environmental protection equipment; research…
